# Helvety Tasks

> Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields in current supported flows. Organize tasks across spaces and stages with drag-and-drop. Engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management app with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com): Main Helvety website with company information and legal pages
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Official store for Helvety products and services (currently free tools, SaaS, and paid subscriptions)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): PDF toolkit currently available at no cost
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (source-visible, not open source)
